 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Year': [2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022],
    'East Africa': [12.1, 13.0, 14.3, 15.1, 16.2],
    'West Africa': [15.0, 16.2, 17.8, 18.5, 20.1],
    'Southern Africa': [10.8, 11.7, 12.9, 13.8, 14.8],
    'North Africa': [13.7, 14.6, 15.9, 17.0, 18.2],
    'Central Africa': [9.5, 10.2, 11.3, 12.0, 13.0]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df.set_index('Year', inplace=True)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
colors = ['#2c7bb6', '#d7191c', '#fdae61', '#abdda4', '#66c2a5']

for i, region in enumerate(df.columns):
    plt.plot(df.index, df[region],
             marker='o',
             label='North Africa' if region == 'East Africa' else ('East Africa' if region == 'North Africa' else region),
             color=colors[i],
             linewidth=2.5)

plt.title('Short-Term Debt Sustainability Trends in African Regions (2018-2022)',
          fontsize=14, pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Debt Sustainability Index', fontsize=12)
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
plt.legend(title='Region', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.xticks(df.index)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.gca().set_ylim(8.97, 19.3)
plt.savefig('output.png')
